about: Where a recipe card on the page says more than its JSON-LD (#119, #120). Data only, read by both apps; rationale in docs/decisions.md. version: raise it on every edit (a copy fetched later would be used only if newer). cards: ingredient lists on any site (recipe plugins); sites: by host without www., each with its own cards, tried before those. A card: list, the element holding the ingredients; item, one ingredient; heading, a group's name (used only if it is h1-h6, ends in a colon or is wholly bold); title, an element inside the list to ignore; amount, elements inside an item left out when matching it (the card writes 'cups' where JSON-LD writes 'c.'). A card only adds the group headings JSON-LD drops, and only when its items line up one-to-one with JSON-LD's recipeIngredient: the same count, each item's letters and digits found in its line. stepNoise: phrases that start noise at the end of the last step (a note on when the recipe was published); from the phrase on is dropped. Selectors: a tag, .class, #id, [attr], [attr=v], [attr^=v], [attr*=v], compounded, in comma lists; no combinators. Values are case-sensitive.
